title: Find the account ID of the client who made a credit card withdrawal (VYBER
question: Find the account ID of the client who made a credit card withdrawal (VYBER KARTOU) in 1998 with an amount below the average 1998 transaction amount, and whose associated loan has the highest approved amount. Also return the largest single transaction amount made by this client.

prediction.sql:
WITH avg_1998 AS (
    SELECT AVG("XCL_051") AS avg_amount
    FROM trans
    WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', "XCL_048") = '1998'
),
qualifying_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t."XCL_047" AS account_id
    FROM trans AS t
    WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', t."XCL_048") = '1998'
      AND t."XCL_050" = 'VYBER KARTOU'
      AND t."XCL_051" < (SELECT avg_amount FROM avg_1998)
),
loan_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        l."XCL_034" AS account_id,
        l."XCL_036" AS loan_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY l."XCL_036" DESC) AS rn
    FROM loan AS l
    WHERE l."XCL_034" IN (SELECT account_id FROM qualifying_accounts)
),
target AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan_ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
max_trans AS (
    SELECT
        t."XCL_047" AS account_id,
        MAX(t."XCL_051") AS largest_transaction_amount
    FROM trans AS t
    WHERE t."XCL_047" IN (SELECT account_id FROM target)
    GROUP BY t."XCL_047"
)
SELECT
    tgt.account_id,
    mt.largest_transaction_amount
FROM target AS tgt
JOIN max_trans AS mt ON tgt.account_id = mt.account_id

WITH avg_1998 AS (
    SELECT AVG("XCL_051") AS avg_amount
    FROM trans
    WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', "XCL_048") = '1998'
),
qualifying_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t."XCL_047" AS account_id
    FROM trans AS t
    WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', t."XCL_048") = '1998'
      AND t."XCL_050" = 'VYBER KARTOU'
      AND t."XCL_051" < (SELECT avg_amount FROM avg_1998)
),
loan_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        l."XCL_034" AS account_id,
        l."XCL_036" AS loan_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY l."XCL_036" DESC) AS rn
    FROM loan AS l
    WHERE l."XCL_034" IN (SELECT account_id FROM qualifying_accounts)
),
target AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan_ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
max_trans AS (
    SELECT
        t."XCL_047" AS account_id,
        MAX(t."XCL_051") AS largest_transaction_amount
    FROM trans AS t
    WHERE t."XCL_047" IN (SELECT account_id FROM target)
    GROUP BY t."XCL_047"
)
SELECT
    tgt.account_id,
    mt.largest_transaction_amount
FROM target AS tgt
JOIN max_trans AS mt ON tgt.account_id = mt.account_id

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT a."XCL_001" AS account_id, MAX(t2."XCL_051") AS largest_transaction_amount
FROM account AS a
INNER JOIN loan AS l ON a."XCL_001" = l."XCL_034"
INNER JOIN trans AS t1 ON a."XCL_001" = t1."XCL_047"
INNER JOIN trans AS t2 ON a."XCL_001" = t2."XCL_047"
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', t1."XCL_048") = '1998'
  AND t1."XCL_050" = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND t1."XCL_051" < (SELECT AVG("XCL_051") FROM trans WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', "XCL_048") = '1998')

WITH avg_1998 AS (
    SELECT AVG(XCL_055) AS avg_amount
    FROM trans
    WHERE strftime('%Y', XCL_048) = '1998'
),
credit_card_withdrawals_1998 AS (
    SELECT 
        t.XCL_047 AS account_id,
        t.XCL_055 AS amount
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.XCL_053 = 'VYBER KARTOU'
      AND strftime('%Y', t.XCL_048) = '1998'
      AND t.XCL_055 < (SELECT avg_amount FROM avg_1998)
),
loan_max_approved AS (
    SELECT 
        l.XCL_034 AS account_id,
        l.XCL_038 AS approved_amount
    FROM loan l
    WHERE l.XCL_039 = 'A'
),
target_accounts AS (
    SELECT 
        cca.account_id
    FROM credit_card_withdrawals_1998 cca
    JOIN loan_max_approved lma ON cca.account_id = lma.account_id
    WHERE lma.approved_amount = (
        SELECT MAX(approved_amount)
        FROM loan_max_approved
    )
),
client_max_trans AS (
    SELECT 
        t.XCL_047 AS account_id,
        MAX(t.XCL_055) AS max_amount
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.XCL_047 IN (SELECT account_id FROM target_accounts)
    GROUP BY t.XCL_047
)
SELECT 
    ta.account_id,
    cmt.max_amount
FROM target_accounts ta
JOIN client_max_trans cmt ON ta.account_id = cmt.account_id

react.raw_react_sql:
WITH avg_1998 AS (
    SELECT AVG("XCL_051") AS avg_amount
    FROM trans
    WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', "XCL_048") = '1998'
),
qualifying_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t."XCL_047" AS account_id
    FROM trans AS t
    WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', t."XCL_048") = '1998'
      AND t."XCL_050" = 'VYBER KARTOU'
      AND t."XCL_051" < (SELECT avg_amount FROM avg_1998)
),
loan_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        l."XCL_034" AS account_id,
        l."XCL_036" AS loan_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY l."XCL_036" DESC) AS rn
    FROM loan AS l
    WHERE l."XCL_034" IN (SELECT account_id FROM qualifying_accounts)
),
target AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan_ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
max_trans AS (
    SELECT
        t."XCL_047" AS account_id,
        MAX(t."XCL_051") AS largest_transaction_amount
    FROM trans AS t
    WHERE t."XCL_047" IN (SELECT account_id FROM target)
    GROUP BY t."XCL_047"
)
SELECT
    tgt.account_id,
    mt.largest_transaction_amount
FROM target AS tgt
JOIN max_trans AS mt ON tgt.account_id = mt.account_id
